label: DEMO 1: Product Specification → Primary Standard & Related Graph
query: 15 kW three phase squirrel cage induction motor, 415 V, 50 Hz for continuous industrial operation with energy efficiency and IP55 protection requirements.
notes: Classic multi-parameter engineering specification: Retrieves IS 12615:2018 (IE3 efficiency), extracts 15 kW / 415V / IP55, and maps normative references to IS 15999 and IS/IEC 60034.

label: DEMO 2: Paraphrased Wording → Dense Vector Semantic Retrieval
query: Industrial prime mover with squirrel-cage rotor driven by alternating current for municipal pump house continuous duty with low energy losses.
notes: Semantic vector superiority test: Query uses 'prime mover', 'squirrel-cage rotor', and 'low energy losses' (terms absent from standard title), yet all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense embeddings correctly match IS 12615:2018.

label: DEMO 3: Multi-Parameter Technical Engineering Spec (Transformer)
query: Outdoor oil immersed distribution transformer 250 kVA, 11 kV / 433 V, 50 Hz, 3-phase, with BEE 5-Star energy loss levels and mineral insulating oil.
notes: Validates exact technical ratings: 250 kVA, 11 kV, 433 V, BEE 5-star losses, and cross-links transformer oil standard IS 335:2018.

label: DEMO 4: Compound Multi-Requirement Procurement Tender (3 Items)
query: Supply of three-phase 15 kW induction motors for municipal water works; low-voltage motor control center (MCC) switchgear panels with 415V busbars; and personal protective industrial safety helmets for site operators.
notes: Compound tender test: System identifies 3 distinct requirement groups (Motor -> IS 12615, Control Panel -> IS/IEC 61439, Safety Helmet -> IS 2925) and retrieves independent recommendations for each item.

label: DEMO 5: Legacy Tender Audit → Superseded Standard Detection
query: Supply of three-phase squirrel cage induction motor manufactured as per IS 325:1996 and 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement conforming to IS 8112:1989 for pump station works.
notes: Obsolescence audit test: Detects obsolete IS 325:1996 and IS 8112:1989 in requirement text, generates high-priority warning alerts, and recommends current IS 12615:2018 and IS 269:2015.

label: DEMO 6: Civil Infrastructure & Normative Testing (Cement & Concrete)
query: Fly ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) for reinforced concrete foundation and marine civil engineering works with compressive strength testing.
notes: Demonstrates pozzolana fly-ash matching, relations to IS 456 (concrete code) and IS 4031 (compressive strength testing).

label: DEMO 7: Earthquake Resistant Structural Steel Rebars (Civil)
query: High strength thermo-mechanically treated TMT steel bars grade Fe 500D for earthquake resistant reinforced concrete structures with high ductility.
notes: Matches Fe 500D grade rebar, elongation and bend testing to IS 1608/IS 1599, and seismic detailing to IS 13920:2016.

label: DEMO 8: Personal Protective Safety Footwear & Head Protection (PPE)
query: Personal protective industrial safety footwear with 200 Joules impact resistant steel toe cap, oil and chemical resistant sole, and anti-static properties for factory personnel.
notes: Demonstrates PPE classification, 200J steel toe impact testing, slip resistance, and mandatory Scheme-I ISI mark under Footwear QCO.

label: DEMO 9: Utility Solar PV Modules & Grid Inverter (Renewable)

notes: Demonstrates Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) flagging, relations to IS/IEC 61730 safety tests, and anti-islanding inverter codes.

label: DEMO 10: Out-of-Catalog Query → Low Confidence Rejection

notes: Thresholding validation: Gracefully detects non-standard query (dense similarity < 0.33), suppresses primary recommendation, and displays low-confidence disclaimer.
